aggregate.shuffle: independent condition-label permutation within each seed; grouped/nested evaluation repeated

nested_temporal.shuffle: independent condition-label permutation within each seed; grouped/nested evaluation repeated

description: Condition labels shuffled independently within each seed; all grouped folds and inner bin selection rerun

nested_window.shuffle: labels independently permuted within seed; max of ten grouped window accuracies per shuffle (family-wise conservative null)

aggregate_selected_population.shuffle: condition labels permuted within each seed; DN F ranking refit from training seeds; max accuracy over all five sizes per shuffle (conservative family-wise null)

temporal_selected_population.shuffle: labels permuted independently within seed; DN F rankings refit from training seeds; maximum grouped accuracy over all 4 temporal bin sizes × 5 population sizes per shuffle (conservative family-wise null)
